description: Totals and subtotals in the Svelte 5 pivot engine. createPivotModel emits subtotal rows per row-axis group, a grand-total row at the bottom and a grand-total column at the right, each switched by the rowSubtotals, grandTotalRow and grandTotalCol config flags; the chevron in the row header expands and collapses each group. The demo flips each toggle independently, marks subtotals with a badge, tints the grand-total row with the accent and the grand-total column amber, with a legend that stays in sync.

faq.question: How do I turn subtotals off?
faq.answer: Set rowSubtotals: false in the createPivotModel config. The engine then emits only leaf rows and the grand total, and the row headers lose their subtotal entries.

faq.question: How do I style total rows differently?
faq.answer: Each emitted row carries __pivotKind, one of group, leaf, subtotal or grandTotal; rowClass reads it and returns a class, which is how the demo tints the grand-total row and badges the subtotals.

faq.question: Is the grand-total column computed per row?
faq.answer: Yes. For every row it aggregates the row's values across all column-axis members with the measure's aggregator, so it is a sum for sums and an average for averages.
